native.kit.text:
myCarlos recovery kit

Recovery key: {key}
Key label: {label} (not secret: it tells kits apart)
Saved on: {date} (UTC)

What it is for
If you forget your myCarlos passphrase, this key opens your vault on this device and lets you choose a new passphrase. It works once you have finished the check in myCarlos that follows saving this kit.

Keep it safe
- Keep this kit somewhere private and away from the device, for example printed and stored with your important papers. Anyone with this key and a copy of your vault can open it.
- If you set up a new recovery key, this one no longer opens the vault on this device.
- Neither your clinic nor the makers of myCarlos can open your vault for you.
